review.scientific: Internal review of FLS2, BAK1, BIK1, LysM receptors, RBOHD topology, calcium and MAPK signaling, stomatal defense, pmr4 and cooperative PTI–ETI against retrieved studies. Recalculated receptor occupancy 0.75, Nernst potential 118.253 mV, osmotic 0.2477572 MPa, chi-square 0.53333, trapezoidal area 110, interaction 6, qPCR 8-fold, half-life 4; all 52 answer mappings checked. Teaching datasets explicitly illustrative.
review.editorial: Separate internal review of ten-section progression, 163 unique teaching paragraphs, 13 labeled SVGs with sequential figure captions, 52 explained questions, 15 misconceptions including why traps arise and 12 recall prompts. Corrected diagram topology, graph label placement, receptor terminology and table identifiers; preserved inherited responsive reader and dynamic neighbor links. Saved audit repeated.
